//: Production holds NO secrets and NO hostnames. Everything that differs between deployments comes from the environment; this file exists to make the safe posture the default rather than something each deployment has to remember. StartupConfigValidator refuses to start if a value committed to this repository reaches a non-Development environment.

Database.//: false so several replicas starting together cannot race the same schema change. Run migrations as a deploy step: dotnet PdfEngine.API.dll --migrate-and-exit

Cors.//: Set Cors__AllowedOrigins__0 to the dashboard origin, e.g. https://app.example.com
